request.style: English, solo male folk voice, acoustic guitar, cello, soft percussion, warm and contemplative, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Uthai son of Ammihud stands tall
Son of Omri in the ancient hall
From the line of Imri he came
Son of Bani bearing the name

[Chorus]
Roots in Judah deep and true
Part of Perez family tree
In Jerusalem they lived with care
From the days of old to now

[Verse]
Next to Jericho the men built
Zaccur son of Imri stood
He raised the wall with steady hands
Restoring what the exile planned

[Chorus]
Roots in Judah deep and true
Part of Perez family tree
In Jerusalem they lived with care
From the days of old to now

[Bridge]
Descendants of Perez son of Judah
Living in the city’s heart
Together with Benjamin and Ephraim
Rebuilding the broken wall

[Chorus]
Roots in Judah deep and true
Part of Perez family tree
In Jerusalem they lived with care
From the days of old to now

[Outro]
Son of Bani name remembered
In the genealogy’s song
